<?php
echo "before|";
$x = 1;
$alias =& $x;
$one = new class($x) {
    public $value;
    public function __construct(&$ref) {
        $ref += 10;
        $local = 2;
        $ref =& $local;
        $ref = 77;
        $this->value = $ref;
    }
};
echo $x, "|", $alias, "|", $one->value, "|";
$two = new class($missing153) {
    public function __construct(&$ref) { $ref = 13; }
};
echo $missing153, "|after";

<?php
$x153 = "4";
$outside153 =& $x153;
eval(<<<'CODE'
namespace Ref153Author;
function make153Author() {
    global $x153;
    return new class(a: 1, b: 2, c: 3, last: $x153) {
        public $seen;
        public function __construct($a, $b, $c, int &$last) {
            echo (int) ($last === 4), "|";
            $last += $a + $b + $c;
            $this->seen = $last;
            $last = "changed";
        }
    };
}
$one153 = make153Author();
echo $one153->seen, "|";
CODE);
echo $x153, "|", $outside153, "|after";

<?php
function value153Author() { echo "value|"; return 3; }
function later153Author() { echo "later|"; return 0; }
echo "before|";
$one = new class(value153Author(), later153Author()) {
    public $seen;
    public function __construct(&$first, $later) {
        echo "ctor|";
        $first += 2;
        $this->seen = $first;
    }
};
echo $one->seen, "|after";

<?php
$pos = "7";
$pos_alias =& $pos;
$pos_other = 30;
$one = new class($pos, ($pos =& $pos_other)) {
    public function __construct(int &$value, $ignored) {
        echo "pos|", $value, "|";
        echo $value === 7 ? "coerced|" : "raw|";
        $value = 9;
    }
};
echo $pos, "|", $pos_alias, "|", $pos_other, "|";
echo $pos_alias === 9 ? "old-cell|" : "wrong-cell|";
$named = "8";
$named_alias =& $named;
$named_other = 40;
$two = new class(ignored: ($named =& $named_other), value: $named) {
    public function __construct(int &$value, $ignored) {
        echo "named|", $value, "|";
        $value = 11;
    }
};
echo $named, "|", $named_alias, "|", $named_other, "|";
echo $named_alias === "8" ? "old-string|" : "changed|";

<?php
function later153Review() { echo "later|"; return 2; }
echo "before|";
try {
    $value = new class(1, later153Review()) {
        public function __construct(&$value, $ignored) {
            echo "ctor|";
        }
    };
} catch (Error $error) {
    echo $error->getMessage(), "|";
}
echo "after|";

<?php
function make153Default() {
    return new class(tail: 9) {
        public $seen;
        public function __construct(int &$head = 3, $tail = 0) {
            $head += 1;
            $this->seen = $head + $tail;
        }
    };
}
$one = make153Default();
$two = make153Default();
echo $one->seen, "|", $two->seen, "|after";
